title: Anime Chronicles Episode 4
summary: In this episode, the protagonist Yae Miko stands in a grand shrine courtyard, her fox ears and pink hair gleaming. As she slowly turns her head to look directly at the camera, petals fall gently from the cherry blossom tree, creating a serene and enchanting atmosphere. Yae's expression shifts from thoughtful to enigmatic, with a subtle smile playing on her lips. The camera captures the delicate details of her shrine maiden outfit, accentuating the beauty of the scene.
